name: Colab GPU (Community) for Orca
description: Community plugin: use a Google Colab GPU runtime as a compute backend from your local Orca workspace and agents. Unofficial; not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

cover.alt: The Colab GPU panel in Orca: agent runs, guardrails and live output of a job on a Tesla T4

settings.title: orca-colab command on remote Orca servers
settings.description: Used inside workspaces that live on a remote Orca server (the panel then shows that server's Colab state). Needs orca-colab v0.2.0 or newer (the 'watch' command); defaults to the same command as 'orca-colab command'. For a checkout on the server: node /path/to/orca-colab/bin/orca-colab.mjs

settings.title: Open the bridge terminal on remote servers automatically
settings.description: For projects on a remote Orca server the panel needs one terminal per server running `orca-colab watch`; by default the plugin opens it in the first project that needs it. Turn off to start that terminal yourself.
